macros.name: getfirstpoint
macros.doc: The commands \getfirstpoint and \getlastpoint can be used to access the first and last point of the current path, respectively.

macros.name: getfirstslope
macros.doc: The commands \getfirstslope and \getlastslope can be used to access the slope at the first and last point of the current path, respectively.

macros.name: getintersectioncircles
macros.doc: Inside a hawkdraw environment, the command \getintersectioncircles can be used to access the intersection points of two circles.

macros.name: getintersectionlinecircle
macros.doc: Inside a hawkdraw environment, the command \getintersectionlinecircle can be used to access the intersection points of a line and a circle.

macros.name: getintersectionlines
macros.doc: Inside a hawkdraw environment, the command \getintersectionlines can be used to access the intersection point of two lines.

macros.name: getlastpoint
macros.doc: The commands \getfirstpoint and \getlastpoint can be used to access the first and last point of the current path, respectively.

macros.name: getlastslope
macros.doc: The commands \getfirstslope and \getlastslope can be used to access the slope at the first and last point of the current path, respectively.

macros.name: getpageheight
macros.doc: The commands \getpagewidth and \getpageheight can be used to access the width and height of the current page, respectively.

macros.name: getpagewidth
macros.doc: The commands \getpagewidth and \getpageheight can be used to access the width and height of the current page, respectively.

macros.name: getpoint
macros.doc: Inside a hawkdraw environment, the command \getpoint can be used to access the coordinates of a point on the current path.

macros.name: getpointx
macros.doc: Inside a hawkdraw environment, the commands \getpointx and \getpointy can be used to access the x- and y-coordinate of a point, respectively.

macros.name: getpointy
macros.doc: Inside a hawkdraw environment, the commands \getpointx and \getpointy can be used to access the x- and y-coordinate of a point, respectively.

macros.name: hawkdrawarrayitem
macros.doc: The command \hawkdrawarrayitem can be used to reference items in an array.

macros.name: hawkdrawarrayset
macros.doc: The command \hawkdrawarrayset can be used to define arrays of values.

macros.name: hawkdrawmap
macros.doc: The command \hawkdrawmap can be used to repeat whole paths.

macros.name: hawkdrawset
macros.doc: The command \hawkdrawset is used to set options.

macros.name: hawkdrawsetcolor
macros.doc: The command \hawkdrawsetcolor is used to define colors using the l3color module.

macros.name: path
macros.doc: The command \path is used to to draw a path inside the hawkdraw environment.

macros.name: stroke
macros.doc: The command \stroke is a shortcut for \path [stroke] .

envs.name: hawkdrawsoftmask
envs.doc: A soft mask can be defined using the hawkdrawsoftmask environment.

envs.name: scope
envs.doc: The scope environment is only available inside the hawkdraw environment. It can be used to create scopes for the localization of path states, style settings and clipping regions.
